_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated. The operator dashboard (docs/seo_analyzer_PRD.md F16, D28) is virtual: no
clrType, no documents. OperatorDashboardActions.OnLoadAsync scaffolds it and sets the breadcrumb (the page title);
Read/OperatorDashboard is the Administrators' (security.json), which also hides its menu entry from everyone else.
The page lists the abuse log (the audit-log query); the SPA draws the usage and storage figures from
GET /seotester/admin/dashboard, which answers only a caller with the same right.
